# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Reduce the risk of missing crucial drug development insights

In drug development where every day matters, AdisInsight empowers you to quickly understand what’s
happening and why, so you can reduce risk, make smarter strategic decisions and act with complete
confidence.

[Request demo][21] [Speak with our experts][22]

## Latest key drug data and intelligence at your fingertips

AdisInsight gives you a reliable view of the drug data landscape, giving you easy access to raw data
and key drug insights when you need them most.

Minimize risk, maximize opportunities

## Start benefiting from AdisInsight today

AdisInsight is a database for drug research and development, disease treatment and decision making,
based on trusted, scientifically sound data. AdisInsight brings together essential scientific
information on drugs in commercial development, key clinical trials, deals, patents and safety
profiles, in one easy-to-use database.

[icon]

## Human validation

Our data is vetted, validated, and given context by human experts. It is this additional layer of
review that gives you unparalleled value.

[icon]

## Data you can trust

Effortlessly and efficiently find the drug data you need for a multitude of use cases. So no matter
what you’re looking for, you can always make confident decisions using accurate data you can trust.

[icon]

## Competitive advantage

Get easy access to the drug data and drug insights you need to stay ahead of the competition.

[icon]

## One window, limitless opportunities

Explore commercial opportunities, competitor insights, investment possibilities, and drug
development opportunities with a single at-a-glance view of the drug landscape.

## Want to learn more about the benefits of AdisInsight?

[Get more information][23]
[people using technology]

Meet AdisInsight

## Knowledge and expertise earned over 40 years as an industry leader

We’re pioneers and experts in providing rich, reliable, high-quality data solutions that give you
the trustworthy insights you need to make smarter strategic decisions.

We’re transparent around where our data comes from, how we validate it, and how we add context. This
gives you insights you can trust, so all stakeholders can act with complete confidence.

Our experience gives us a unique perspective on the challenges you face today, helping you see the
world of drug development more clearly.

We’ve a proven track record of established partnerships and collaborations across health regulatory,
academic, government, medical, pharmaceutical and academic organizations, helping them to reduce
risk with a single view of the drug landscape.

Flexibility and choice

## Data on demand, the way you need it

You can opt to get our rich, validated data plugged straight into your internal analytics platforms
and systems via XML data feed or APIs, so you have the freedom to explore and analyze the data to
meet your specific needs.

# Reduce the risk of missing crucial drug development insights

In drug development where every day matters, AdisInsight empowers you to quickly understand what’s
happening and why, so you can reduce risk, make smarter strategic decisions and act with complete
confidence.

[Request demo][21] [Speak with our experts][22]

## Latest key drug data and intelligence at your fingertips

AdisInsight gives you a reliable view of the drug data landscape, giving you easy access to raw data
and key drug insights when you need them most.

Minimize risk, maximize opportunities

## Start benefiting from AdisInsight today

AdisInsight is a database for drug research and development, disease treatment and decision making,
based on trusted, scientifically sound data. AdisInsight brings together essential scientific
information on drugs in commercial development, key clinical trials, deals, patents and safety
profiles, in one easy-to-use database.

[icon]

## Human validation

Our data is vetted, validated, and given context by human experts. It is this additional layer of
review that gives you unparalleled value.

[icon]

## Data you can trust

Effortlessly and efficiently find the drug data you need for a multitude of use cases. So no matter
what you’re looking for, you can always make confident decisions using accurate data you can trust.

[icon]

## Competitive advantage

Get easy access to the drug data and drug insights you need to stay ahead of the competition.

[icon]

## One window, limitless opportunities

Explore commercial opportunities, competitor insights, investment possibilities, and drug
development opportunities with a single at-a-glance view of the drug landscape.

## Want to learn more about the benefits of AdisInsight?

[Get more information][23]
[people using technology]

Meet AdisInsight

## Knowledge and expertise earned over 40 years as an industry leader

We’re pioneers and experts in providing rich, reliable, high-quality data solutions that give you
the trustworthy insights you need to make smarter strategic decisions.

We’re transparent around where our data comes from, how we validate it, and how we add context. This
gives you insights you can trust, so all stakeholders can act with complete confidence.

Our experience gives us a unique perspective on the challenges you face today, helping you see the
world of drug development more clearly.

We’ve a proven track record of established partnerships and collaborations across health regulatory,
academic, government, medical, pharmaceutical and academic organizations, helping them to reduce
risk with a single view of the drug landscape.

Flexibility and choice

## Control how you access data

[network icon]

## Data on demand, the way you need it

You can opt to get our rich, validated data plugged straight into your internal analytics platforms
and systems via XML data feed or APIs, so you have the freedom to explore and analyze the data to
meet your specific needs.

[Learn more][24]
[api icon]

## Rich content and analysis via our platform

Benefit from additional layers of analysis and insights provided by our team of experts, giving you
the relevant stories behind the data. So in an industry where every day matters, you can quickly
understand what’s happening, why, and what you should do next.

[Learn more][25]
[growth icon]

## Master complex trends with industry reports

The research and development landscape in the pharmaceutical sector is constantly changing, and
research into the latest trends is complex. Using data extracted from the AdisInsight database, our
subject matter experts craft detailed reports on areas of interest and newsworthy drug intelligence.

[Learn more][26]

## AskTheExpert for answers to your most pressing questions

We know that grappling with new data isn’t always easy. That’s why our AskTheExpert feature allows
you to directly contact our team of subject matter experts—real people who are happy to answer any
questions you may have.

[Ask a question][27]

Proud heritage, exciting future

## Our commitment to continuous innovations and improvements

We’ve led the drug data industry for over 40 years. We are innovating every day to make it easier
and faster for you to find what you need, exactly when you need it, and in the way you need it.

01

## AskAdis Chatbot

Whether you’re conducting academic research or working in industry, AskAdis revolutionizes how you
search and access data by providing precise answers and related sources for any industry-specific
queries.

[screenshot of dashboard]
02

## Dashboards

Convenient dashboards help you stay up to date with current drug and trial development for a
specific indication. Access real-time visualizations of critical data and insights related to the
drug development process.

[demo of askAdis]
03

## Visualizations

Create engaging charts and graphs from key variables across your search results. Effortlessly
integrate information from AdisInsight into your presentations and reports to bring your search to
life.

[screenshot of platform]
[screenshot of dashboard] [demo of askAdis] [screenshot of platform]

## See the power of AdisInsight for yourself by requesting a demo.

[Request demo][28]

> “I have completed more than 100 evaluations using AdisInsight. It is absolutely critical that the
> information I include is proven and trustworthy and it has been so every time. The reports I
> create are shared with management and there has never been a fault in what I have put together”.

Business Development & Licensing Manager, Top 50 Pharma company

> “The only resource available with this kind of information all in one place."

Medical Information Pharmacist, acute public teaching hospital

> “I personally have never felt the need to use another source as I have always found the
> information I needed in AdisInsight. The scientific information is particularly well curated. One
> thing that is quite unique is the inclusion of interactions with regulatory authorities –
> submissions, negative opinions or refused approvals with reasons and requests for new trials or
> further data. All of this is pivotal and it is great that AdisInsight includes this information in
> such a comprehensive manner.”

Business Development & Licensing Manager, Top 50 Pharma company

## data insights.

### AdisInsight brings trusted pharma intelligence into Claude

Eligible subscribers to both Claude and AdisInsight are now able to query and interact with
AdisInsight directly within the Claude interface. The integration is delivered via a secure Model
Context Protocol (MCP) server and Claude Connectors, allowing Claude to retrieve and ground
responses in licensed AdisInsight content in real time, while preserving provenance, access controls
and usage tracking. Contact us at asktheexpert.adisinsight@springer.com to learn more.

**iPSC-derived cell models shipped directly from US and European hubs. [Discover more.][64]

## Supporting research & drug discovery with iPSC technology

Axol manufactures cells and provides services across five key areas, neuroscience – including ALS,
Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s, Parkinson’s – neuroinflammation, ophthalmology dermatology and
cardiovascular.

### Neuroscience

iPSC-derived models for neuroscience ➤

### Cardiovascular

iPSC-derived models for cardiotoxicity and cardiac research ➤

### Ophthalmology

iPSC-derived models and services for retinal research and drug development ➤

### Dermatology

iPSC-derived models for dermo-cosmetics and drug discovery ➤

### Axol Bioscience – reliable physiologically relevant iPSC-derived disease models

Axol Bioscience is a leading provider of human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) technologies,
specializing in the manufacture of high-performance iPSC-derived cells and the delivery of
industry-leading laboratory services. With over a decade of expertise, Axol partners with global
pharmaceutical companies, contract research organizations (CROs), biotechnology firms, start-ups,
and academic institutions to advance the use of iPSC-based models in drug discovery and disease
research.

We operate across five key areas, neuroscience (including ALS, Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s,
Parkinson’s, neuroinflammation), ophthalmology (Dry-AMD, ophthal-inflammation), dermatology, and
cardiovascular.

Axol offers scalable solutions including iPSC banking, reprogramming, gene editing, cell
manufacturing, and quality control. The company is committed to closing the translational gap,
developing physiologically relevant *in vitro* systems that improve consistency and relevance in
human disease modeling and compound testing.

Axol is recognized for its scientific excellence, transparent collaboration, and rigorous quality
standards, with manufacturing operations certified to ISO 9001:2015.

Modeling the genomic instability of HD

iPSC lines from five HD patients and one asymptomatic carrier. CENSOi019-B line (HTT: 14/127 CAG,
now CAG143) displays instability in culture and is associated with accelerated disease onset.
Striatal neurons derived from this iPSC line provide a model for longitudinal studies of repeat
expansion and neurodegeneration and recapitulate key HD phenotypes: CAG instability, neurite
pathology, and functional deficits.

[Learn more][65]

Compound efficacy and toxicity testing using human iPSC‑derived retinal organoids, enabling

systems for retinal toxicity with cell viability (ATP-based assays), morphological assessment, and
short- and long-term treatment regimes.

[Contact Axol Bioscience][63]

**Supporting global preclinical drug discovery
**iPSC-derived cell models shipped directly from US and European hubs. [Discover more.][64]

## Supporting research & drug discovery with iPSC technology

Axol manufactures cells and provides services across five key areas, neuroscience – including ALS,
Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s, Parkinson’s – neuroinflammation, ophthalmology dermatology and
cardiovascular.

### Neuroscience

iPSC-derived models for neuroscience ➤

### Cardiovascular

iPSC-derived models for cardiotoxicity and cardiac research ➤

### Ophthalmology

iPSC-derived models and services for retinal research and drug development ➤

### Dermatology

iPSC-derived models for dermo-cosmetics and drug discovery ➤

### Axol Bioscience – reliable physiologically relevant iPSC-derived disease models

Axol Bioscience is a leading provider of human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) technologies,
specializing in the manufacture of high-performance iPSC-derived cells and the delivery of
industry-leading laboratory services. With over a decade of expertise, Axol partners with global
pharmaceutical companies, contract research organizations (CROs), biotechnology firms, start-ups,
and academic institutions to advance the use of iPSC-based models in drug discovery and disease
research.

We operate across five key areas, neuroscience (including ALS, Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s,
Parkinson’s, neuroinflammation), ophthalmology (Dry-AMD, ophthal-inflammation), dermatology, and
cardiovascular.

Axol offers scalable solutions including iPSC banking, reprogramming, gene editing, cell
manufacturing, and quality control. The company is committed to closing the translational gap,
developing physiologically relevant *in vitro* systems that improve consistency and relevance in
human disease modeling and compound testing.

Axol is recognized for its scientific excellence, transparent collaboration, and rigorous quality
standards, with manufacturing operations certified to ISO 9001:2015.

## Products and research services spotlight

Modeling the genomic instability of HD

iPSC lines from five HD patients and one asymptomatic carrier. CENSOi019-B line (HTT: 14/127 CAG,
now CAG143) displays instability in culture and is associated with accelerated disease onset.
Striatal neurons derived from this iPSC line provide a model for longitudinal studies of repeat
expansion and neurodegeneration and recapitulate key HD phenotypes: CAG instability, neurite
pathology, and functional deficits.

[Learn more][65]
Retinal organoids for discovery and retinal toxicity

Compound efficacy and toxicity testing using human iPSC‑derived retinal organoids, enabling
assessment of therapeutic response, mechanism of action. Optimised retinal organoid-based screening
systems for retinal toxicity with cell viability (ATP-based assays), morphological assessment, and
short- and long-term treatment regimes.

[Learn more][66]

iPSC-derived motor neurons and complex triculture systems provide a physiologically relevant human
model for ALS research. These advanced co-culture platforms recapitulate key ALS phenotypes,
including motor neuron degeneration, neuroinflammatory responses, and functional

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

## Improving the lives of those affected by peripheral neuropathy

1 in 11 Americans is affected by peripheral neuropathy.

*The* Foundation *for* peripheral neuropathy serves as the resource of information for patients. We
are focused on accelerating cures for peripheral neuropathy (PN), funding collaborative efforts of
leading scientists, and raising awareness for the disease.

[ Donate Now ][90]
[ Read Our Annual Report ][91]

## Patient and caregiver resources

### What is PN?

Peripheral neuropathy is not a single disease. It is a general term for a series of disorders that
result from damage to the body’s peripheral nervous system.

[ Learn More ][92]

Have you recently been diagnosed with PN? Help and resources are just a click away.

special interest in PN.

## Research & healthcare provider resources

[Icon of a person moving.]

### Peripheral Neuropathy Research Registry

Founded in 2008 by the Foundation, this unique biobank of biological samples from PN patients will
facilitate both basic and clinical research studies that are expected to improve scientists’
understandings of PN.

[ Learn More ][97]
[Icon of a doctor.]

### Clinical Trials

Clinical trials are conducted to collect data regarding the safety and efficacy of new drug and
device developments. Participating in a trial is an invaluable way of supporting the pursuit of PN
cures.

[ Clinical Trials ][98]
[Icon of a microscope.]

### Apply for a Grant

The Foundation is committed to supporting the goal of developing treatments for PN.

[ Learn More ][99]

## The millions of patients with PN deserve more

We’re striving to find more treatments, fund more research and offer more ways for patients of PN to
live better.

[Icon of a microscope.]

## Research

We fund some of the most brilliant minds in neuroscience to advance the discovery of new PN
therapies and cures.

[Icon of people having ideas.]

## Awareness

We continue to raise awareness for PN and the need for more research and treatment options that
work.

[Icon of a brain as a lightbulb.]

## Patient resources

The Foundation offers a collection of free, peripheral neuropathy educational resources, videos,
brochures, and transcripts for patients, caregivers, physicians, and more.

## Patient and caregiver resources

### What is PN?

Peripheral neuropathy is not a single disease. It is a general term for a series of disorders that
result from damage to the body’s peripheral nervous system.

[ Learn More ][92]

[Scientists in a lab.]

## Research & healthcare provider resources

[Icon of a person moving.]

### Peripheral Neuropathy Research Registry

Founded in 2008 by the Foundation, this unique biobank of biological samples from PN patients will
facilitate both basic and clinical research studies that are expected to improve scientists’
understandings of PN.

[ Learn More ][97]
[Icon of a doctor.]

### Clinical Trials

Clinical trials are conducted to collect data regarding the safety and efficacy of new drug and
device developments. Participating in a trial is an invaluable way of supporting the pursuit of PN
cures.

[ Clinical Trials ][98]
[Icon of a microscope.]

### Apply for a Grant

The Foundation is committed to supporting the goal of developing treatments for PN.

[ Learn More ][99]

## The millions of patients with PN deserve more

We’re striving to find more treatments, fund more research and offer more ways for patients of PN to
live better.

[Icon of a microscope.]

## Research

We fund some of the most brilliant minds in neuroscience to advance the discovery of new PN
therapies and cures.

[Icon of people having ideas.]

## Awareness

We continue to raise awareness for PN and the need for more research and treatment options that
work.

[Icon of a brain as a lightbulb.]

## Patient resources

The Foundation offers a collection of free, peripheral neuropathy educational resources, videos,
brochures, and transcripts for patients, caregivers, physicians, and more.

The Hypermobility Syndromes Association is here to support everyone with symptomatic hypermobility
to manage their condition well – whatever the cause, however mildly or severely they may be
affected, and whether or not they are diagnosed.

Hypermobility is:

Where joints bend further than average, and affects around 30% of the population. Around 10% of
these people live with symptoms which can range from mild to disabling, can affect many of the
body's systems (not just the joints), and vary over time. Find out more about [hypermobility and the
conditions which can cause it here][36]. Find out more about [living well with hypermobility
here][37].

[supportive hands.png]

###### How we can help

##### Our charity has a holistic, solution-focused approach to living well with a hypermobility
##### syndrome, our expert patients, volunteers, and clinical advisory board provide
##### management-focused patient support groups, and educational programs, information, and advice
##### to hypermobile people and their wider support network, including health and social care
##### professionals.

Hypermobility is:

Where joints bend further than average, and affects around 30% of the population. Around 10% of
these people live with symptoms which can range from mild to disabling, can affect many of the
body's systems (not just the joints), and vary over time. Find out more about [hypermobility and the
conditions which can cause it here][36]. Find out more about [living well with hypermobility
here][37].

##### Our charity has a holistic, solution-focused approach to living well with a hypermobility
##### syndrome, our expert patients, volunteers, and clinical advisory board provide
##### management-focused patient support groups, and educational programs, information, and advice
##### to hypermobile people and their wider support network, including health and social care
##### professionals.

Are Klinic’s services available in my area?

Yes, Klinic’s telehealth services are available nationwide, so you can receive care no matter where
you are. Whether you need addiction treatment, weight loss consultations, or mental health support,
Klinic connects you with licensed professionals who are ready to help, no matter your location.

How does Klinic support weight loss treatments?

Klinic offers personalized weight loss treatment plans that may include medications like GLP-1
agonists (e.g., semaglutide) and emerging options like Retatrutide. Providers assess your health
history, goals, and eligibility before recommending any medication.

What should I do if I need a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications?

To get a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications, schedule an online
consultation with one of Klinic’s healthcare providers. After reviewing your medical history and
needs, they will recommend a treatment plan and provide the necessary prescription.

Can Klinic help with non-surgical weight loss options?

Yes, Klinic provides non-surgical weight loss solutions, including prescription medications like
GLP-1 agonists, along with lifestyle and diet recommendations to help you lose weight safely and
effectively.

How quickly can I see results with weight loss treatments from Klinic?

Results vary depending on the treatment and individual factors. However, with medications like
Semaglutide and a customized weight loss plan, many patients begin to see results within a few weeks
to months.

Can I receive addiction treatment through Klinic's platform?

Yes, Klinic offers confidential and professional addiction treatment through telehealth services.
Whether you're seeking Suboxone, addiction therapy, or other recovery solutions, our platform
connects you with qualified healthcare professionals who can provide ongoing support and
prescription for medications from the comfort of your home.

What should I do if I need addiction treatment but can't visit a clinic in person?

If you can't visit a clinic in person, Klinic's telehealth platform allows you to receive addiction
treatment remotely. Our platform connects you with professional providers who can prescribe
medications like Suboxone and offer counseling sessions to support your recovery.

Can I receive long-term support for opioid addiction through Klinic’s platform?

Yes, Klinic offers ongoing addiction support through virtual consultations, follow-up appointments,
and medication management to help maintain long-term recovery.

Is telehealth addiction treatment as effective as in-person treatment?

Yes, telehealth addiction treatment through Klinic is highly effective. Studies show that online
therapy and medication-assisted treatment (MAT) can be as effective as in-person care, especially
with convenient follow-ups and ongoing support.

Does Klinic accept insurance for prescriptions and consultations?

Yes, Klinic accepts hundreds of insurance plans, including Medicare and Medicaid, for both
prescriptions and consultations. You can check with our team to verify if your specific insurance
plan is accepted before scheduling a consultation.

Can I get Suboxone or other addiction medications without insurance?

Yes, Klinic offers addiction treatment, including Suboxone prescriptions, even without insurance.
During your consultation, our healthcare professionals will discuss payment options and provide
affordable treatment solutions to ensure you receive the care you need for recovery.

Can I use my insurance for addiction treatment through Klinic?

Yes, Klinic accepts many insurance plans for addiction treatment services, including Suboxone
prescriptions and therapy. You can verify your coverage with our team to ensure you can access
treatment through your insurance provider.

How can I find out if Klinic accepts my insurance for weight loss or mental health services?

To find out if Klinic accepts your insurance for weight loss or mental health services, simply
contact our team. We accept a wide range of insurance plans, including Medicare and Medicaid, and
our support team will be happy to assist you with coverage inquiries.

licensed healthcare providers. After evaluating your medical needs, the healthcare provider will
prescribe medications such as addiction or weight loss treatments, all through an online
consultation process.

What kind of medical services can I access through Klinic?

Klinic provides a wide range of services, including addiction treatment, weight loss programs,
mental health support, and more. You can consult with licensed professionals for conditions like
depression, obesity, and addiction, and receive prescriptions and personalized care plans remotely.

Is Klinic legit for getting prescriptions online?

Absolutely. Klinic works only with licensed, board-certified medical providers who follow all
federal and state telemedicine regulations. Your prescriptions are issued only when medically
appropriate, ensuring safety and compliance.

How do I schedule a consultation on Klinic?

Scheduling a consultation on Klinic is simple. Visit our website, go to [klinic.com/membership
][5]choose the service you need (e.g., weight loss or addiction treatment), and book an appointment
with one of our healthcare professionals. Consultations should be virtual.

Is it safe to get prescriptions online through Klinic?

Yes, it is safe. Klinic is a licensed telehealth platform that ensures your privacy and security.
Our healthcare providers are fully certified and follow strict guidelines to deliver high-quality
medical care and prescriptions for medications like Tirzepttide, Suboxone, and others.

How do I know if Klinic is the right platform for me?

Klinic is ideal for individuals looking for accessible, professional healthcare services. Whether
you need addiction treatment, weight loss solutions, or mental health care, Klinic’s telehealth
platform connects you with qualified healthcare providers who offer personalized care based on your
needs.

Are Klinic’s services available in my area?

Yes, Klinic’s telehealth services are available nationwide, so you can receive care no matter where
you are. Whether you need addiction treatment, weight loss consultations, or mental health support,
Klinic connects you with licensed professionals who are ready to help, no matter your location.

How does Klinic support weight loss treatments?

Klinic offers personalized weight loss treatment plans that may include medications like GLP-1
agonists (e.g., semaglutide) and emerging options like Retatrutide. Providers assess your health
history, goals, and eligibility before recommending any medication.

What should I do if I need a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications?

To get a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications, schedule an online
consultation with one of Klinic’s healthcare providers. After reviewing your medical history and
needs, they will recommend a treatment plan and provide the necessary prescription.

Can Klinic help with non-surgical weight loss options?

Yes, Klinic provides non-surgical weight loss solutions, including prescription medications like
GLP-1 agonists, along with lifestyle and diet recommendations to help you lose weight safely and
effectively.

How quickly can I see results with weight loss treatments from Klinic?

Results vary depending on the treatment and individual factors. However, with medications like
Semaglutide and a customized weight loss plan, many patients begin to see results within a few weeks
to months.

Can I receive addiction treatment through Klinic's platform?

Yes, Klinic offers confidential and professional addiction treatment through telehealth services.
Whether you're seeking Suboxone, addiction therapy, or other recovery solutions, our platform
connects you with qualified healthcare professionals who can provide ongoing support and
prescription for medications from the comfort of your home.

What should I do if I need addiction treatment but can't visit a clinic in person?

If you can't visit a clinic in person, Klinic's telehealth platform allows you to receive addiction
treatment remotely. Our platform connects you with professional providers who can prescribe
medications like Suboxone and offer counseling sessions to support your recovery.

Can I receive long-term support for opioid addiction through Klinic’s platform?

Yes, Klinic offers ongoing addiction support through virtual consultations, follow-up appointments,
and medication management to help maintain long-term recovery.

Is telehealth addiction treatment as effective as in-person treatment?

Yes, telehealth addiction treatment through Klinic is highly effective. Studies show that online
therapy and medication-assisted treatment (MAT) can be as effective as in-person care, especially
with convenient follow-ups and ongoing support.

Does Klinic accept insurance for prescriptions and consultations?

Yes, Klinic accepts hundreds of insurance plans, including Medicare and Medicaid, for both
prescriptions and consultations. You can check with our team to verify if your specific insurance
plan is accepted before scheduling a consultation.

Can I get Suboxone or other addiction medications without insurance?

Yes, Klinic offers addiction treatment, including Suboxone prescriptions, even without insurance.
During your consultation, our healthcare professionals will discuss payment options and provide
affordable treatment solutions to ensure you receive the care you need for recovery.

Can I use my insurance for addiction treatment through Klinic?

Yes, Klinic accepts many insurance plans for addiction treatment services, including Suboxone
prescriptions and therapy. You can verify your coverage with our team to ensure you can access
treatment through your insurance provider.

How can I find out if Klinic accepts my insurance for weight loss or mental health services?

To find out if Klinic accepts your insurance for weight loss or mental health services, simply
contact our team. We accept a wide range of insurance plans, including Medicare and Medicaid, and
our support team will be happy to assist you with coverage inquiries.

Get Started Today

Get in touch with Klinic to get access to the best Independent Practitioners that accept your
insurance for comprehensive care, available 24/7/365.

# Introducing Maywell Health Comprehensive Pain Management

Live your healthiest, most pain free life!

[ Book your Appointment][91]
[ Contact us: (516) 200 4814 ][92]
[Google Review Logo]

## A Welcome from Dr. Brian Mayrsohn, Founder of Maywell Pain Management Practice

As a comprehensive pain management physician, Dr. Mayrsohn is dedicated to enhancing the lives of
his patients through a [holistic and cutting-edge approach to pain management][93]. With a profound
commitment to patient well-being, Dr. Brian Mayrsohn is compassionate and patient-centered, with a
primary focus on improving patient function and facilitating the ability to enjoy life. His practice
effectively blends the best of cutting-edge clinical medicine with complementary therapies such as
[nutrition][94], psychotherapy, physical therapy, [acupuncture][95], and [chiropractic
medicine][96], setting a new standard in comprehensive pain care.

Innovative Integrative Approach: Dr. Mayrsohn is at the forefront of his field, consistently seeking
out and incorporating the latest advancements in pain management procedures. His unwavering
dedication to researching and utilizing innovative medical breakthroughs safeguards his patients
with the most effective, evidence-based treatments available.

[Learn more][97]

## Our Services

### Next Level Nutrition

Maywell Health, where we believe that good nutrition is the foundation of overall well-being. Our
Nutrition services are designed to provide you with personalized guidance, support, and education to
help you achieve your health goals and improve your quality of life.

[ Explore ][99]

### Pain Management

Welcome to Maywell Health. We understand that living with pain can affect every aspect of your life.
That’s why we use the biopsychosocial model. We assess how your pain impacts your everyday life so
that we can align your goals with your treatment plan.
[ Explore ][100]

### Behavioral Health

Welcome to Maywell Health, where we understand that your mental well-being is as important as your
physical health. Our Behavioral Health services are designed with you in mind, offering personalized
care and support to help you navigate life’s challenges with confidence and resilience.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What services does Maywell Health provide?

Maywell Health offers a variety of services, including: 
* Pain Management 
* Nutrition Services 
* Behavioral Health Support 
* We also make referrals to Physical Therapists, Acupuncturists, Chiropractors, and other relevant
  specialists. 

How do you approach pain management?

The practice utilizes a biopsychosocial model to assess how pain impacts patients’ lives. This
allows for personalized treatment plans that align with each patient’s goals, ensuring a holistic
approach to pain management. 

What conditions can you treat?

Maywell Health specializes in managing various pain conditions, including – 
* Chronic Pain 
* Arthritis 
* Back Pain 
* Neck Pain 
* Headaches 
* Fibromyalgia 
* Sports Injuries 

Our holistic approach allows them to address both physical and psychological aspects of pain. 

How do you incorporate behavioral health into pain management?

Maywell Health recognizes that mental well-being is essential for physical health. Our behavioral
health services offer personalized care and support to help patients navigate life’s challenges,
enhancing resilience and coping strategies. 

What complementary therapies do you provide?

Maywell Health integrates various complementary therapies, including acupuncture, physical therapy,
chiropractic care, and psychotherapy, to enhance pain management and overall well-being. 

What should I expect during my first visit?

During your first visit, you can expect a comprehensive assessment of your pain and its impact on
your life. Dr. Mayrsohn and his team will discuss your health goals and collaboratively develop a
personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs. 

How often will I need to visit for treatment?

The frequency of visits will depend on your individual treatment plan and progress. After your
initial assessment, your healthcare provider will recommend a tailored schedule that aligns with
your goals. 

Can I continue my current medications while receiving treatment?

Yes, you can typically continue your current medications while undergoing treatment at Maywell
Health. However, it’s essential to discuss all medications with your healthcare provider to ensure
safe and effective pain management. 

Do you have experience with Workers’ Compensation?

Yes, [we’ve worked extensively with individuals who have been injured at work][194]. Please call if
you want to discuss your specific case and learn more about how we can guide you through this
challenging time in your life.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What services does Maywell Health provide?

Maywell Health offers a variety of services, including: 
* Pain Management 
* Nutrition Services 
* Behavioral Health Support 
* We also make referrals to Physical Therapists, Acupuncturists, Chiropractors, and other relevant
  specialists. 

How do you approach pain management?

The practice utilizes a biopsychosocial model to assess how pain impacts patients’ lives. This
allows for personalized treatment plans that align with each patient’s goals, ensuring a holistic
approach to pain management. 

What conditions can you treat?

Maywell Health specializes in managing various pain conditions, including – 
* Chronic Pain 
* Arthritis 
* Back Pain 
* Neck Pain 
* Headaches 
* Fibromyalgia 
* Sports Injuries 

Our holistic approach allows them to address both physical and psychological aspects of pain. 

How do you incorporate behavioral health into pain management?

Maywell Health recognizes that mental well-being is essential for physical health. Our behavioral
health services offer personalized care and support to help patients navigate life’s challenges,
enhancing resilience and coping strategies. 

What complementary therapies do you provide?

Maywell Health integrates various complementary therapies, including acupuncture, physical therapy,
chiropractic care, and psychotherapy, to enhance pain management and overall well-being. 

What should I expect during my first visit?

During your first visit, you can expect a comprehensive assessment of your pain and its impact on
your life. Dr. Mayrsohn and his team will discuss your health goals and collaboratively develop a
personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs. 

How often will I need to visit for treatment?

The frequency of visits will depend on your individual treatment plan and progress. After your
initial assessment, your healthcare provider will recommend a tailored schedule that aligns with
your goals. 

Can I continue my current medications while receiving treatment?

Yes, you can typically continue your current medications while undergoing treatment at Maywell
Health. However, it’s essential to discuss all medications with your healthcare provider to ensure
safe and effective pain management. 

Do you have experience with Workers’ Compensation?

Yes, [we’ve worked extensively with individuals who have been injured at work][194]. Please call if
you want to discuss your specific case and learn more about how we can guide you through this
challenging time in your life.

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### View All Resources for Providers

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

## О Мелоксидил

Пероральная суспензия Мелоксидил — препарат на основе мелоксикама, специально разработанный для
собак и кошек. Мелоксидил помогает избавиться от боли и улучшить качество жизни животных.[ Читать
полностью][17]

Мелоксидил предназначен для лечения болевого синдрома различной этиологии; заболеваний,
сопровождающихся воспалением мягких тканей, в качестве анальгезирующего и противовоспалительного
средства в послеоперационный период у собак и кошек, а так же для лечения острых и хронических
заболеваний опорно-двигательного аппарата: артритов, артрозов, переломов, синовитов, вывихов и
других.


Узнайте больше о [симптомах остеоартрита ][18]— это первый шаг к улучшению качества жизни вашего
питомца.

Мелоксидил представляет собой подслащенную суспензию, которую большинство животных поедают
добровольно. Так же Мелоксидил допустимо смешивать с кормом.

Мелоксидил удобен в применении и позволяет максимально точно дозировать препарат. Каждая упаковка
Мелоксидил для собак снабжена 2 шприцами-дозаторами: маленький шприц для собак весом до 7 кг и
большой шприц для собак весом более 7 кг. Таким образом, ваша собака получает точную необходимую
дозу НПВП, рассчитанную по весу собаки.


Упаковки Мелоксидил для кошек снабжены одним мерным шприцом – дозатором, позволяющим точно
дозировать суспензию по весу кошки.

ФАРМАКОЛОГИЧЕСКИЕ СВОЙСТВА
+

Мелоксикам, входящий в состав препарата,
относится к нестероидным противовоспалительным лекарственным средствам группы
оксикамов и оказывает противовоспалительное, анальгезирующее и жаропонижающее действие. Мелоксикам
не оказывает отрицательного действия на хрящевую
ткань, что позволяет использовать его в терапии патологий суставов и позвоночника.
Мелоксикам подавляет выработку циклооксигеназы (ЦОГ) в цикле арахидоновой
кислоты, при этом преимущественно подавляется выработка ЦОГ-II, под действием
которой происходит синтез воспалительных простагландинов (ПГЕ1 и ПГЕ2), вызывающих воспаление, отек
и боль.

ПОКАЗАНИЯ
+

МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® применяют собакам для лечения воспаления и купирования болевого синдрома при острых и
хронических заболеваниях опорно-двигательного аппарата (артриты, артрозы, вывихи, отеки, синовиты,
теносиновиты и т.п.).
Применяют в качестве противовоспалительного, жаропонижающего и болеутоляющего препарата при
воспалительных и болевых синдромах различной этиологии, включая
заболевания, сопровождающиеся воспалением мягких тканей, а также в качестве
анальгезирующего и противовоспалительного средства в послеоперационный период.

ДОЗИРОВКА И СПОСОБ ПРИМЕНЕНИЯ
+

МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® применяют с кормом
один раз в сутки в дозе 0,2 мг/кг МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® в первый день лечения, далее в
поддерживающей дозе 0,1 мг/кг МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® в течение 10 дней. Клинический
ответ наступает через 3-4 дня после начала применения препарата. Каждая упаковка
снабжена двумя мерными шприцами, что позволяет максимально точно дозировать
лекарственное средство мелким и крупным породам собак

СОСТАВ
+

Мелоксикам — 1,5 мг/мл.

ФОРМА ВЫПУСКА
+

Суспензия выпускается во флаконах по 10 и 32 мл

УСЛОВИЯ ХРАНЕНИЯ
+

Хранят МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® в упаковке производителя, в сухом,
защищенном от света и недоступном для посторонних лиц месте, отдельно от продуктов питания и кормов,
при температуре от 0 °С до 25 °С.

+

мелоксикаму, язва желудка
и 12-перстной кишки, геморрагический синдром, выраженная печеночная и почечная
недостаточность, беременность и лактация

Метаболиты мелоксикама фармакологически не активны и не опасны для здоровья животного.
После орального введения мелоксикам быстро всасывается, еда не влияет на абсорбацию.

Применяют в качестве противовоспалительного, жаропонижающего и болеутоляющего препарата при

анальгезирующего и противовоспалительного средства в послеоперационный период.

жаропонижающее действие.

антитоксическими свойствами в отношении эндотоксина E. coli, подавляя выработку тромбоксана В2.

Пероральная суспензия Мелоксидил — препарат на основе мелоксикама, специально разработанный для

средства в послеоперационный период у собак и кошек, а так же для лечения острых и хронических
заболеваний опорно-двигательного аппарата: артритов, артрозов, переломов, синовитов, вывихов и

ответ наступает через 3-4 дня после начала применения препарата. Каждая упаковка
снабжена двумя мерными шприцами, что позволяет максимально точно дозировать
лекарственное средство мелким и крупным породам собак

СОСТАВ
+

Мелоксикам — 1,5 мг/мл.

ФОРМА ВЫПУСКА
+

Суспензия выпускается во флаконах по 10 и 32 мл

УСЛОВИЯ ХРАНЕНИЯ
+

Хранят МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® в упаковке производителя, в сухом,
защищенном от света и недоступном для посторонних лиц месте, отдельно от продуктов питания и кормов,
при температуре от 0 °С до 25 °С.

ПРОТИВОПОКАЗАНИЯ
+

Противопоказанием к применению МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® является индивидуальная повышенная чувствительность к
мелоксикаму, язва желудка
и 12-перстной кишки, геморрагический синдром, выраженная печеночная и почечная
недостаточность, беременность и лактация

СРОК ГОДНОСТИ
+

3 года. После вскрытия флакона — 6 месяцев

КАК РАБОТАЕТ
+

Мелоксидил относится к нестероидным противовоспалительным препаратам (НПВС) группы оксикамов.
Мелоксикам, входящий в состав препарата, оказывает противовоспалительное, анальгетическое и
жаропонижающее действие.
Механизм действия мелоксикама заключается в подавлении выработки циклооксигеназы (ЦОГ) в цикле
арахидоновой кислоты, под действием которой происходит синтез воспалительных простагландинов (ПГЕ1 и
ПГЕ2), вызывающих воспаление, жар, отек и боль. Мелоксикам уменьшает инфильтрацию воспаленных тканей
лейкоцитами, в меньшей степени подавляет коллаген-индуцированную агрегацию тромбоцитов, обладает
антитоксическими свойствами в отношении эндотоксина E. coli, подавляя выработку тромбоксана В2.
Мелоксикам относится к ЦОГ-2 селективным НПВП.

участие в регуляции коровотока в почках.

+

МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® относится к нестероидным
противовоспалительным препаратам группы оксикамов. Мелоксикам, входящий
в состав препарата, оказывает противовоспалительное, анальгетическое и жаропонижающее действие.
После однократного орального введения кошкам мелоксикам
достигает максимальной концентрации в плазме крови через 3 часа.

ПОКАЗАНИЯ
+

МЕЛОКСИДИЛ® применяют кошкам в качестве противовоспалительного, жаропонижающего и болеутоляющего
препарата при воспалительных и болевых
синдромах различной этиологии, включая острые и хронические заболевания опорно-двигательного

+

кормления индивидуально перорально в смеси с кормом или непосредственно в рот
один раз в сутки. В первый день лечения препарат применяют в дозе 0,1 мг мелоксикама на 1 кг массы

применением встряхнуть содержимое флакона до образования
однородной суспензии.

+

Мелоксикам — 0,5 мг/мл.

ФОРМА ВЫПУСКА
+

Суспензия выпускается во флаконах по 5 и 15 мл.

+

гастритах), сердечно-сосудистой системы,
печени и почек, геморрагическом синдроме. Не рекомендуется применять препарат
беременным и лактирующим кошкам, котятам моложе 6 недель, а также животным
в состоянии дегидратации

Common questions

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is Miracle Leaf a dispensary?
No. Miracle Leaf is a state-licensed medical marijuana certification clinic network, not a
dispensary. A physician evaluates whether you meet a qualifying condition under state law and, if
appropriate, enters a certification in the state registry. Approved patients then purchase products
from a separate, state-licensed treatment center.
Which states does Miracle Leaf serve?
Miracle Leaf operates clinics in Florida, Georgia, and Texas. Program rules, qualifying conditions,
and fees differ by state, so confirm the details for your state with the clinic or the state
cannabis agency.
How do I find a Miracle Leaf clinic near me?
Choose your state above, then open the clinic directory to see each office address, hours, and
booking options. New clinic pages are added as locations come online.
What happens at a certification evaluation?
A state-licensed physician reviews your medical history and records to determine whether you meet a
qualifying condition. If you qualify, the physician enters a certification in the state registry.
The clinic does not dispense or sell any cannabis product.

Miracle Leaf® is a state-licensed medical marijuana certification clinic network. Our physicians
evaluate whether you meet a qualifying condition under your state program and, when appropriate,
enter a certification in the state registry.

registration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is Miracle Leaf a dispensary?
No. Miracle Leaf is a state-licensed medical marijuana certification clinic network, not a
dispensary. A physician evaluates whether you meet a qualifying condition under state law and, if
appropriate, enters a certification in the state registry. Approved patients then purchase products
from a separate, state-licensed treatment center.
Which states does Miracle Leaf serve?
Miracle Leaf operates clinics in Florida, Georgia, and Texas. Program rules, qualifying conditions,
and fees differ by state, so confirm the details for your state with the clinic or the state
cannabis agency.
How do I find a Miracle Leaf clinic near me?
Choose your state above, then open the clinic directory to see each office address, hours, and
booking options. New clinic pages are added as locations come online.
What happens at a certification evaluation?
A state-licensed physician reviews your medical history and records to determine whether you meet a
qualifying condition. If you qualify, the physician enters a certification in the state registry.
The clinic does not dispense or sell any cannabis product.

**Known for providing Anti Allergic Medicine, Anti Depressant Medicine, Sodium Valproate Tablets IP,
Anti Psychotics Medicine, Anti Vertigo Medicine, and more. **
Neuracle Lifesciences Private Limited is a reliable manufacturer and supplier of Disodium Hydrogen
Citrate Syrup, Anti Depressant Medicine, Sodium Valproate Tablets IP, Anti Psychotics Medicine, Anti
Vertigo Medicine, and more. Our goal is to deliver efficient and dependable healthcare solutions
that enhance the health of people and help improve the pharmaceutical sector.

**State-of-the-Art Infrastructure**

Our company has state-of-the-art infrastructure that allows us to produce and deliver high-quality
pharmaceutical products with ease. Our production units are planned to adhere to the strict
requirements of the pharmaceutical industry, ensuring all products are produced under controlled
conditions. We have sophisticated equipment and technology to ensure precision, quality, and
consistency in every batch. Our infrastructure enables scalability and the capacity to respond to
increasing demand for our products, with the highest standards of safety and compliance with
industry standards.

**Commitment to Quality**

Quality is our priority. We have stringent quality control procedures in place to make sure that all
our products are of the highest pharmaceutical quality. Our drugs are thoroughly tested and quality
checked to make sure that they are effective, safe, and meet regulatory standards. Adhering to Good
Manufacturing Practices (GMP), we make sure that our customers get products that are not only
effective but also safe to use.

**Dedicated and Skilled Team**

We are motivated by success through highly committed and skilled professionals committed to the
delivery of excellence. From research and development, manufacture, and quality assurance, our
professionals collaborate harmoniously to bring innovative solutions to the healthcare industry. We
always invest in continuing education so our employees are on top of industry developments and
regulation, enabling us to maintain a competitive edge within the pharmaceuticals industry.

our products are of the highest pharmaceutical quality. Our drugs are thoroughly tested and quality

effective but also safe to use.

delivery of excellence. From research and development, manufacture, and quality assurance, our
professionals collaborate harmoniously to bring innovative solutions to the healthcare industry. We
always invest in continuing education so our employees are on top of industry developments and

[About][19]

[Science][20]

For almost a decade, Neuropathix has been a leader in the research, development and discovery of
patented novel monotherapeutic agents for targeted drug candidates to treat Chemotherapy Induced
Peripheral Neuropathy (CIPN), Hepatic Encephalopathy (HE), Mild Traumatic Brain Injury (mTBI) and
chronic pain management. Neuropathix has advanced the development of a patented product platform of
innovative Cannabinoid-inspired molecules for patients with these diseases and other significant
medical needs. We have taken a science based, data-driven, validated approach to the discovery and
development of novel and promising therapeutic molecules.

Our subsidiary Kannalife Sciences is the only company in the cannabinoid therapeutics arena to have
licensed the U.S. Government Patent 6,630,507 – “Cannabinoids as Antioxidants and Neuroprotectants”.
Our pre-clinical research on cannabidiol (CBD) and understanding of certain mechanism of action, its
potential and its limitations, has resulted in our own target drug candidate discovery aimed at
improving CBD’s pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic (“PK/PD”) aptitude.

In the discovery of KLS-13019 and other patented Cannabinoid-inspired New Chemical Entities (NCE’s),
we have made significant improvements in the chemistry efficacy and safety of CBD-like molecules
that are up to 200X more potent, 10X more bioavailable, 5X safer and 1000 times more effective than
CBD.

[About][19]

[Science][20]

For almost a decade, Neuropathix has been a leader in the research, development and discovery of
patented novel monotherapeutic agents for targeted drug candidates to treat Chemotherapy Induced
Peripheral Neuropathy (CIPN), Hepatic Encephalopathy (HE), Mild Traumatic Brain Injury (mTBI) and
chronic pain management. Neuropathix has advanced the development of a patented product platform of
innovative Cannabinoid-inspired molecules for patients with these diseases and other significant
medical needs. We have taken a science based, data-driven, validated approach to the discovery and
development of novel and promising therapeutic molecules.

Our subsidiary Kannalife Sciences is the only company in the cannabinoid therapeutics arena to have
licensed the U.S. Government Patent 6,630,507 – “Cannabinoids as Antioxidants and Neuroprotectants”.
Our pre-clinical research on cannabidiol (CBD) and understanding of certain mechanism of action, its
potential and its limitations, has resulted in our own target drug candidate discovery aimed at
improving CBD’s pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic (“PK/PD”) aptitude.

In the discovery of KLS-13019 and other patented Cannabinoid-inspired New Chemical Entities (NCE’s),
we have made significant improvements in the chemistry efficacy and safety of CBD-like molecules
that are up to 200X more potent, 10X more bioavailable, 5X safer and 1000 times more effective than
CBD.

##### INSEAD Strategy • Stanford Genomics • International Medical Pathways

# NORIA — Strategy, Genomics & Premium Healthcare

We combine board-level strategic advisory, AI-enhanced genomics and concierge-level healthcare
services.
From corporate transformation to international diagnostic pathways, NORIA integrates strategy,
science and medical excellence.

[ Discover NORIA ][1]

### Strategy & Enterprise Architecture

We support leaders with strategic advisory, business architecture, capability modelling and digital
transformation across complex organisations.

### Genomics & Virtual Genomia

AI-enhanced genomic analysis, gene–function–phenotype modelling, multi-omics interpretation and
translational research support.

### Noria Health Hub (VIP Healthcare)

Fast-track diagnostic pathways, ENT & allergy care, concierge medical support and international
patient coordination.

## The Three Pillars of NORIA

**Strategy & Enterprise Architecture** — INSEAD-level frameworks, corporate strategy, architecture
governance and digital execution.

**Virtual Genomia** — advanced genomics, data-driven multi-omics integration, phenotype modelling
and AI-native computational biology.

**Noria Health Hub** — premium, coordinated medical pathways for international clients, from
diagnostics to full concierge support.

#### Strategic Depth

INSEAD-level strategic advisory, value mapping and organisational transformation.

#### Scientific Excellence

Advanced genomics, multi-omics biology and computational modelling.

#### AI-Native

Algorithms, automation, workflows, data engineering and simulation.

#### Premium Experience

VIP patient pathways, transfers, hospitality and medical coordination.

## What Our Clients Say

## Running a clinic shouldn't feel this hard

## The old way

Multiple disconnected systems

## The Pabau way

One platform for the whole clinic

One place for bookings, records, and payments
Automated admin so your team focuses on patients
Real-time visibility across your entire team
Scale without adding complexity

Features

## Solutions for every part of your clinic

Your core clinic workflows, connected in one system.

PATIENT CARE & RECORDS

## One place for every clinical decision your team makes

Keep consultations, records, prescriptions, and lab results in one place. Your whole team works from
the same information.
* ✓Structured clinical notes across every appointment
* ✓Prescriptions created and managed in-platform
* ✓Lab requests sent and results received in one workflow
* ✓Compliant records shared securely across the team

[ Explore patient care & records ][148]
SCHEDULING & PAYMENTS

## From first booking to final payment, no admin overhead

From the first appointment to the final payment, everything runs without the admin overhead.
* ✓Book and reschedule in seconds via the patient portal
* ✓Digital forms and consent sent before they arrive
* ✓Payments, deposits, and invoices handled in one place
* ✓Waitlist fills cancelled slots automatically

[ Explore scheduling & payments ][149]
Operations & Team

## Less time on paperwork. More time for patients

Automate the repetitive work so your team can focus on what matters: patients.
* ✓Patients checked in and documented in minutes
* ✓Pre-built templates that cut documentation time
* ✓Staff rotas, commissions, and timesheets in one place
* ✓Compliance and reporting that keeps you in control

[ Explore operations & team ][150]
GROWTH & INSIGHTS

## More patients, higher retention, and full visibility over your revenue

See exactly how your clinic is performing. Track revenue, retention, and team activity, all in one
view.
* ✓Revenue, retention and KPIs reports at a glance
* ✓Memberships and packages that grow patient lifetime value
* ✓Email, SMS, and campaigns built into the same platform
* ✓Loyalty and referral programs that bring patients back

[ Explore growth & insights ][151]

## AI built for everyday clinic work

[Try Pabau AI][152]
AI SCRIBE AGENT

### Turn voice into structured clinical notes

AI listens during your consultation and generates structured treatment notes and consult summaries.
You focus on the patient, not the screen

PRESCRIBING AGENT

### Prescribe faster, with safety checks built in

Real-time safety checks run automatically against the patient record so prescriptions are accurate,
every time.

[Prescribing Agent - real-time safety checks][Prescribing Agent - real-time safety checks]
LETTERS AGENT

### Personalised clinical letters in one click

Generate referral letters, summaries, and patient communications instantly. Drafted from the patient
record and ready to send.

[Letters Agent - personalised clinical letters][Letters Agent - personalised clinical letters]

## It pays for itself fast

Reduce Admin Time

### 43% reduction in admin time

Practices report spending significantly less time on scheduling, clinical notes and follow-ups after
switching to Pabau.

Onboarding

### 2.4x faster staff onboarding

New staff get up to speed in days, not weeks, thanks to guided setup and intuitive workflows.

Patient Lifetime Value

### 32% increase in patient lifetime value

Automated follow-ups, loyalty and revenue-boosting tools keep patients coming back and spending
more.

ROI

### 2x ROI from admin savings alone

Practices save an average of 10 hours per week on admin. At typical staff costs, that's double the
subscription cost before counting revenue gains.

the US, Canada, UK and Europe.

right onto FM 1488. Then turn right onto Horseshoe Bend.. Finally, turn right, and Pain MD Houston
will be in front.

We’re open Monday-Friday 08:00 – 17:00

For additional questions, you can call us at (346)272-0025 or find us on [Yelp][166]

##### What services does Pain MD Houston offer for pain management in The Woodlands, TX?

Pain MD Houston provides a variety of pain management treatments, including spinal cord stimulation,
ketamine therapy, and various injection therapies, specifically tailored for patients experiencing
chronic and acute pain in the Woodlands area.

##### How can I schedule an appointment at the pain management clinic in Woodlands, TX?

You can schedule an appointment by calling Pain MD Houston at 346-272-0025 or by visiting their
website to fill out a contact form.

##### What types of pain conditions do you treat at your Woodlands pain relief center?

The clinic treats a range of conditions including back pain, joint pain, migraines, and neuropathic
pain, utilizing advanced techniques in pain management treatment in Woodlands.

##### Are the treatments at Pain MD Houston personalized for each patient?

Yes, treatments are individualized based on the specific needs and conditions of each patient,
ensuring effective pain management tailored to their circumstances.

##### What is the experience level of the staff at Pain MD Houston?

Dr. Mukalel and his team have extensive experience in interventional pain medicine, with Dr. Mukalel
having completed a fellowship in Acute Pain Medicine and holding leadership roles in various medical
institutions.

##### What should I expect during my first visit to the pain management clinic in The Woodlands?

During your first visit, you will undergo a comprehensive evaluation to discuss your medical history
and current pain issues, followed by recommendations for appropriate pain management treatment
options.

##### Do you offer any minimally invasive procedures for pain treatment in Woodlands, TX?

Yes, Pain MD Houston specializes in minimally invasive procedures such as spinal cord stimulation
and various injection therapies designed to alleviate pain without extensive recovery times.

Welcome to the Pain Treatment Institute

# Your Path to Living Pain Free

Led by board-certified pain management doctor, Dr. Syed. our team offers comprehensive pain care.

Pain can feel overwhelming, but there is hope for relief. Pain management physicians are dedicated
to helping people overcome pain and live their best lives.
By combining medical expertise with a compassionate approach, they can develop a personalized
treatment plan to address your specific needs.

From simple lifestyle changes to advanced medical interventions, we’re committed
to helping you find the path to a pain-free future.

Complete our free pain questionnaire to find out if you are a candidate for our treatments.

[ View More About Us ][159]
[ Pain Questionnaire ][160]

Best Service for your Health

### Back Pain

Back pain can be treated with a number of different procedures. Depending on the location, source,
and severity of your back pain, some of the procedures we use are:

Medication
Physiotherapy
Nerve block
Epidural steroid injection
Spinal cord stimulator
Radio frequency
Pain pumps
[ Read More ][161]

### Hip Pain

At the Pain Treatment Institute, our pain management physicians look for conservative, non-surgical
treatment options first. Our pain management physicians will complete an evaluation of the hip joint
to determine the best treatment. Some treatment options could be:
Rest
Ice and heat intervals
Stretching
Regenerative treatments
Injections
Anti-Inflammatory medicine
[ Read More ][162]

### Knee Pain

There are non-surgical treatment options for knee pain. Depending on the cause of knee pain our
treatment options may include:
Rest
Anti-inflammatory medications
Physical therapy
A brace or splint
Steroid injections
Nerve blocks
Radiofrequency ablation
Peripheral nerve stimulation
[ Read More ][163]

### Nerve Pain

If you have sciatica, pain management can help. Our pain management physicians have the experience
to properly treat sciatica. We look for conservative treatments first. Those include:

Medication management
Physical therapy
Steroid injections

If conservative pain management treatments are not working then surgery may be recommended.

[ Read More ][164]

### Foot & Ankle Pain

Foot and ankle pain can significantly impact your daily life, making it difficult to walk or engage
in physical activities. At our pain management clinic, we offer a variety of treatments to help
alleviate discomfort and improve mobility. Treatment options may include:

Physical therapy
Medications
Steroid Injections
Bracing or Orthotics
Minimally Invasive Procedures
Surgical Interventions
[ Read More ][165]

### Head / Neck Pain

Acute or chronic neck pain should never be taken lightly. Maintaining good posture is always a
proper first step to treatment or prevention. However, when you need relief from neck pain, our
conservative pain treatments can help. Treatments may include:

Medication
Physical therapy
Regenerative medicine
Injections
Nerve blocks
Radiofrequency ablation
[ Read More ][166]

### Joint Pain

We offer non-surgical treatment options for joint pain. Based on the cause of joint pain, our
treatments may include:
Rest
Physical therapy
Medication management
Injections
[ Read More ][167]

### Leg Pain

Depending on the location and cause of leg pain our treatment options may include:

Rest
Anti-inflammatory medications
Physical therapy
Steroid injections
Nerve blocks
Radiofrequency ablation
Peripheral nerve stimulation
[ Read More ][168]

### Shoulder Pain

We always recommend conservative, non-surgical treatment options first. Those may include:

Rest
Anti-inflammatory medications
Physical therapy
Medication management
Steroid injections
Nerve blocks
[ Read More ][169]
